art_note: The imagery relies on composited mockups and generic lifestyle shots that detract from a luxury aesthetic.
desc_en: A fluid silhouette designed for the warm season. This midi dress features a subtle layered design with delicate spaghetti straps and a soft round neckline. The elastic waistband includes an adjustable drawstring to define the figure with precision. A side slit detail introduces fluidity and movement to the piece. Crafted from lightweight materials with a soft hand.
desc_es: Una silueta fluida diseñada para la temporada cálida. Este vestido midi presenta un sutil diseño en capas con delicados tirantes finos y un escote redondo. La cintura elástica incorpora un cordón ajustable que define la figura con precisión. Una abertura lateral aporta fluidez y movimiento a la prenda. Confeccionada con materiales ligeros de tacto suave.
details_en:
· Composition: 100% polyester
· Fit: Elastic waistband with adjustable drawstring

· Care: Hand wash or machine wash with water under 45°C. Do not bleach. Do not soak for long periods
